summary: This room is the DSP/synthesis-math neighborhood — Kuramoto, Floquet/Mathieu, Bessel functions, granular and particle synthesis, Dispersion, Frequency-Time Duality — already very densely cross-linked to each other and to Hyperdimensional Prism; the folder workers won't be blind to much inside that cluster. The genuine gaps this lens found were at the edges: two newcomers (Audition Gate, Reflective Practice) that name the same Schön reflection-in-action pattern from opposite directions — one abstract, one sound-specific — and had never met; a directed flag on Loudon Live's RTM section that's a straightforward pointer fix now that LDN RTM exists as its own project; and one stale-comment compost (Octave Equivalence) that's been waiting a full weave cycle for exactly this confirmation. I did not find a genuine merge inside the room — Generative Sample/Wavetable Libraries look like duplication but are an intentional, documented split, and forcing anything further would have been the "link you had to force" the brief warns against.

typed_relations.label: reflection-in-sound
typed_relations.rationale: Both newcomers, both under-reached (Audition Gate 0 inbound, Reflective Practice 1 inbound). Audition Gate is a sound-domain instance of exactly the Schön reflection pattern Reflective Practice names: the spec is suspended and perception takes over. Neither entry currently knows the other exists.
typed_relations.evidence: Audition Gate: "The audition is non-negotiable. It is not a review of the spec; it is a check that the spec's intent landed in the audio." (Audition Gate.md:34) — Reflective Practice: "The situation talks back, the practitioner listens, and as he appreciates what he hears, he reframes the situation once again." (Reflective Practice.md:47-49)

typed_relations.label: iterated-by-ear
typed_relations.rationale: The entry's own account of its build is a worked instance of the audition-gate practice — evaluated and revised by listening, not by spec review.
typed_relations.evidence: "the instrument was then iterated by ear across eight audio renders" (Bayesian Granular Synthesizer.md:39); "Wire the optional grain-entrainment coupling and audition whether population-locking adds to the condensation or muddies it." (:75)

typed_relations.label: expose-vs-conceal
typed_relations.rationale: Latent Error's whole discipline is making structural failure visible ("redesign so failure requires more than one simultaneous mistake"). Compressor Design's own link names Trickster's soft-knee move as hiding the discontinuity it's smoothing over. Same design surface, opposite instinct — worth sharpening from a flat connects-to into a named tension rather than replacing it outright; offered for Concierge judgment, not a forced overwrite.
typed_relations.evidence: Latent Error.md:37 "don't design for idealized attention, redesign so failure requires more than one simultaneous mistake" — Compressor Design.md:25-27 target Trickster label "soft-knee-hides-discontinuity"

entry_health_flags.vector_issue: No forward_vector field at all in frontmatter — unusual in this room, where nearly every other entry (even seeds and sprouts) carries one. Flagging only; not rewriting.

flag_responses.proposed_change: Loudon Live.md § The RTM series (lines ~95-97) currently describes the RTM format inline without linking out. LDN RTM.md now exists as its own project (born 2026-09, already `member-of` Loudon Live). Propose: (1) trim the RTM-series paragraph to a pointer sentence — e.g. "...a planned content series sits alongside the project staging: **[[LDN RTM]]**, Read The Manual" — and move the shortlist/voice detail into LDN RTM.md if it isn't already there; (2) add a reciprocal frontmatter link Loudon Live → LDN RTM (type enables or connects-to, label rtm-series), since currently the relation only runs one direction (LDN RTM → Loudon Live, member-of). Second half of the flag — whether Loudon Live's outbound links now reflect what feeds it — is already resolved: Loudon Live.md:15-60 carries 18 outbound links to its curriculum sources (Toolkit — Synthesizers, Toolkit — Audio Plugins, Crystal Synthesizer, Generative Audio Devices, etc.), so SUBSTRATE's 2026-08-25 "emitted none" finding is stale and can be closed.
